brief:
## A5. Marking watched keeps the place: accept

- reason: a mark made by accident loses nothing.
- condition: JS-218 criterion added: "A title marked played by hand keeps its place and gets it back when unmarked. A title played to its end has no place to return, and starts from the beginning."
- entry: "Marking played by hand keeps the place. Unmarking returns it. Finishing a title clears it."
tradeoff: A mark made by accident loses nothing.
entry: Marking played by hand keeps the place. Unmarking returns it. Finishing a title clears it.
